results.title: Norris to test McLaren’s Hypercar at Portimão before Azerbaijan GP
results.description: Lando Norris will head to Portimão on the Monday after the Spanish Grand Prix for a test in McLaren’s 2027 Hypercar. The reigning world champion already got behind the wheel of the new machine earlier this year, and will now rack up mileage on Portuguese asphalt to further contribute to the Hypercar’s development.
